basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old college student from Groningen, originally from India. I'm passionate about gaming, especially roguelikes like 'Enter The Gungeon'. I enjoy meeting new people online and often play games through Steam. Outside gaming, I'm pursuing a degree in computer science and have a keen interest in cybersecurity. I usually browse Reddit during evenings and late nights, often juggling between study sessions and gaming. Currently single, I enjoy exploring different cultures and cuisines. I'm also a budding photographer, experimenting with platforms like VSCO.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in computer science and gaming. I have been gaming since I was a child and have self-taught many skills in programming and cybersecurity. My academic path in computer science has broadened my knowledge base and practical skills.
